artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact symbolic derivation of the two residual constants and high-precision evaluation of the defining cubic Fibonacci tail.
Deterministic output of verify.py showing the exact constants and scaled numerical convergence.

limitations: The theorem concerns only reciprocal Fibonacci cubes. No new exact floor formula or least threshold is claimed. Originality is best-of-knowledge over a broad historical literature.
provenance: Previously published mathematical finding; fresh independent mathematical audit passed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: Sharp residual expansion for cubic reciprocal Fibonacci tails
scientific_context: A sharp two-term residual expansion and convergent local all-order expansion for the inverse tail of reciprocal Fibonacci cubes, refining the known difference-to-zero approximation and eventual \(2/F_n\) error window.
